questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 16 cm and a height of 7 cm. Take your time: what is its area?

block.label: Quick Recall
block.sub: Four options, one answer — keep it fast

questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 16 × 7 = 56 cm². Halving matters — skipping it doubles the answer to 112.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A cylinder has radius 3 cm. What is the circumference of its circular end?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: Circumference = 2πr = 2 × π × 3 ≈ 18.84 cm; mixing this up with area (πr²) or doubling incorrectly gives the wrong distractors.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a sealed container, 27g of reactants react completely. What is the mass of the products?
questions.why: Mass is conserved in a closed system, so the products weigh the same as the reactants that formed them: 27g.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What do we call the solid that suddenly forms when two liquids react together?
questions.why: A precipitate is a solid that suddenly forms and settles out when two liquids react together, showing a chemical change.
